value.text: Leonardo's draft letter offering his services

claims.statement: A draft letter in the Codex Atlanticus, not in Leonardo's usual hand, addressed to the 'Illustrissimo Signor mio', lists military engineering abilities and offers to make the bronze horse. The addressee is identified with Ludovico; the date c.1482 is an estimate.

value.text: Letter of 29 June 1497 urging completion of the Last Supper

claims.statement: A ducal memorandum of 29 June 1497 to Marchesino Stanga asks that Leonardo finish the Last Supper so that he can start the other wall of the refectory.

sources.cite: Standard biographies. Model recall, not checked in this session.

value.text: Gift of the vineyard at Porta Vercellina, 1498 to 1499

claims.statement: Ludovico granted Leonardo a vineyard outside Porta Vercellina; the deed is dated 26 April 1499 in most accounts. Half of it was left to Battista de Vilanis and half to Salai in the will of 1519.
